full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad with R&B influences. The arrangement features a bright acoustic guitar playing syncopated strumming patterns and a clean electric guitar providing melodic fills. A warm synth bass follows the kick drum pattern. The percussion consists of a crisp snare on the backbeat and a steady kick drum. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, melodic tenor with light vibrato and occasional breathy textures. The track is in the key of G Major at 82 BPM in 4/4 time.
